card.name: Linking words in repeated website disclaimers
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation (by, to, and, a comma, a closing parenthesis) inside repeated website notices and disclaimers. Also fires on digits inside numeric tables.

modes.label: Website notice phrases
modes.description: Linking words inside stock site messages such as login prompts, editing instructions and browser notes.
modes.example: Simply begin typing or use the editing tools above<< to>> add to this article.

modes.label: Medical disclaimer wording
modes.description: The word 'and' in 'any and all medical conditions' in a standard consultation disclaimer.
modes.example: A licensed medical professional should be consulted for diagnosis and treatment of any<< and>> all medical conditions.

modes.label: Numbers in tables
modes.description: Commas or digits inside numeric ranges in tables.

card.plain: It reacts to small connecting words in stock website messages and disclaimers, and to some digits in tables.
